name: Believe the One

provenance.detail: No named sermon playlist contains this upload. It appears only in Watch Messages, so it stays Standalone Sunday.
The YouTube title is Believe the One, matching this single guest message rather than a multi-week series name.
Jeremy assigned Believe the One as a solo message with He Is Risen, grouped as standalone rather than folded into Ezekiel : A New Heart.

description: Brad Hinkle on Naaman, a servant girl, and being the one who speaks because you believe the One.
note: New Year guest message from an elder. No named playlist. Not part of Ezekiel : A New Heart.

provenance.detail: Brad reads Luke 4 then 2 Kings 5 as the body of the message and titles the charge believe the One, then be the one.
Jeremy confirmed this January 5 sermon as a standalone.
